Abbott highlighted the well's strong performance and reserves potential, explaining how a specialist monobore design with cemented casing and targeted perforations is helping optimise production. Although initial output reached around 3,000 barrels per day, Arrow is managing flow rates to maximise ultimate reservoir recovery rather than short-term production. Looking ahead, the company has identified six additional drilling locations at Icaco, while the recently spudded IC-HZ10 is targeting the Ubaque formation. Abbott outlined the potential for further reserves growth and rapid well payback under Colombia's fiscal regime.
